title: Atypical chest discomfort documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports documenting concerns, uncertainty, questions, explanation of reviewed tests, shared decisions, and clinician-provided advice for recurrent pain without generating patient instructions.
user_facing_items.population: Adults with recent-onset acute or stable chest pain or discomfort suspected to be cardiac in origin.
user_facing_items.setting: Initial, urgent, primary, outpatient, and specialist assessment of recent-onset chest pain.
restrictions: Exact for clinician-documented chest-pain history, associated symptoms, risk context, examination and reviewed tests, information, and safety-net discussion. It is old and only partial for atypical or established non-acute follow-up; diagnosis, urgency, testing, treatment, and referral decisions are not generated.
